'''Dr. Abby''' (Japanese: '''アヤネ''' ''Ayane'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. She is a {{tc|Doctor|Pokémon Doctor}} living in [[Foothill Town]] who specializes in natural Pokémon medicine. She is also a [[Top Coordinator]].

==History==
Dr. Abby debuted in ''[[AG060|Delcatty Got Your Tongue]]''. She was working at her Pokémon clinic when {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived and asked her to treat [[May's Skitty]], who had lost its voice after inhaling smoke released by [[Ash's Torkoal]]. Although {{an|May}} was worried about her Skitty, Dr. Abby assured her there was nothing to worry about as she massaged the {{pkmn|category|Kitten Pokémon}}. She was able to heal Skitty in no time by stimulating its pressure points, helping it get its voice back. Later, Ash noticed a [[Photography|picture]] of Abby with a {{p|Skitty}} and May remembered having read about Abby in an issue of the {{DL|Magazines in the Pokémon world|Coordinator Monthly}} magazine. The group then sat down to talk about Abby's {{pkmn|journey}} as a [[Pokémon Coordinator]], her achievements, and her career change.

Dr. Abby was teaching May's Skitty to juggle when a [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|disguised]] {{TRT}} appeared with {{MTR}} faking an injury. While Abby was treating Meowth, he started talking, thus blowing their cover. At this moment, [[Jessie]] and [[James]] revealed themselves and proceeded to capture Dr. Abby's {{p|Delcatty}}, [[nickname]]d Johnny, and May's Skitty before escaping in their [[Team Rocket's mechas|hot-air balloon]]. Abby then chased after the balloon together with the group in order to get her Pokémon back, warning Team Rocket that Johnny wouldn't like being captured.

When Johnny destroyed the balloon with a powerful {{m|Solar Beam}} attack, Abby and May joined forces against Jessie and James, with Johnny and Skitty facing off against {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}} and {{TP|James|Cacnea}}. During their battle, Johnny used a variety of moves, including {{m|Blizzard}}, which Abby and Johnny taught Skitty how to use. After that, the two cat-like Pokémon teamed up and used the {{type|Ice}} [[move]] to finish the battle.

Dr. Abby made a cameo appearance in ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]'', where she was watching May competing in the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] on [[television]].

==Character==
[[File:Abby and Dr Moss.png|thumb|220px|Abby and Dr. Moss]]
Along with being a renowned {{tc|Doctor|Pokémon Doctor}}, Abby is an accomplished [[Pokémon Coordinator]]. For her achievements in the Contest world, she was labeled as a '''Legendary Coordinator''' (Japanese: '''伝説のコーディネーター''' ''Legendary Coordinator''). When she was younger, she managed to collect the required {{pkmn|Contest}} [[Ribbon]]s to enter the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] with Johnny's help.

During the competition, she obtained a perfect score in the [[Appeal|Appeals Round]] and defeated each one of her opponents in the [[Contest Battle]]s, thereby winning the [[Ribbon Cup]] and the title of [[Top Coordinator]]. After winning, she decided to travel for a while in order to learn more about {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. However, her big victory went over her head and she became overconfident. One day, when she was challenged to a [[Pokémon battle]], she didn't stop to consider whether she was prepared or not. This clouded her judgment and she lost the battle, with Johnny falling off a cliff in the process and being seriously injured.

Abby was desperately searching for someone to treat Johnny when she discovered a Pokémon clinic. The owner, [[Dr. Moss]], was able to heal Johnny successfully and she became inspired to study to be the sort of Doctor he was. She then decided to quit coordinating and convinced Dr. Moss to make her his apprentice. After many trial-by-errors, Abby eventually learned all about the benefits of pressure points and massages for Pokémon. As a prize for her outstanding work, she was given a [[Moon Stone]] by Dr. Moss, enabling Johnny to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a {{p|Delcatty}}.

Nowadays, Abby is a very down-to-earth person with a calm and collected attitude. She currently runs her own Pokémon clinic in [[Foothill Town]], where she helps Pokémon recover from [[Illness in the Pokémon world|illnesses]].
